parts:
This could be a problem with your ggplot syntax.
Instead of this:
ggplot(Marker, aes(x=Marker[Marker.row(),3], y=Marker[Marker.row(),4])) +
            geom_point(shape=1)
try this:
ggplot(Marker[Marker.row(),], aes(x=Lower, y=Value)) +
            geom_point(shape=1)

But Marker[Marker.row(),] has no sense if Marker.row()returns a dataframe.
